description: This file implements classes and functions related to feature setup and flag processing within the 'cuttlefish' namespace, including methods for running setup sequences, processing flags, and generating XML help documentation for flags.

classes.name: SetupFeature
classes.description: Represents a feature that requires setup, with methods for running setup sequences.

classes.name: FlagFeature
classes.description: Represents a feature that can process flags and generate help XML documentation.

methods.name: SetupFeature::RunSetup
methods.description: Executes the setup process for a list of features, respecting dependencies and order.

methods.name: FlagFeature::ProcessFlags
methods.description: Processes a list of flags for a set of features, ensuring proper handling and dependency resolution.

methods.name: FlagFeature::WriteGflagsHelpXml
methods.description: Generates an XML document describing the flags for features, suitable for help documentation.
